chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. al-Fadl b. al-Abbas al-Baghdadi, a shaykh for the people of hadith, narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali b. Ibrahim informed us. He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ghalib b. Harb al-Dabbi al-Tamtami and Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Uthman b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. They said: Yahya b. Salim, the cousin of al-Hasan b. Salih — and the former was preferred over al-Hasan b. Salih — narrated to us. He said: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Atiyya, from Jabir. He said: The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said:

On the gate of Paradise, it is written: 'There is no god but God, Muhammad is the Messenger of God, Ali is the brother of the Messenger of God,' two thousand years before God created the heavens and the earth.

key_terms.أخو رسول الله: The brother of the Messenger of God — a title of Imam Ali signifying his unique spiritual bond with the Prophet
key_terms.باب الجنة: The gate of Paradise — the entrance to the eternal abode of the righteous
key_terms.لا إله إلا الله: There is no god but God — the shahada, the fundamental declaration of Islamic monotheism

ai.seo_question: What is inscribed on the gate of Paradise according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) reveals that inscribed on the gate of Paradise are three declarations: 'There is no god but God, Muhammad is the Messenger of God, Ali is the brother of the Messenger of God,' and that this inscription predates the creation of the heavens and earth by two thousand years. Narrated through a long chain including the prominent companion Jabir b. Abd Allah al-Ansari, this hadith affirms both the primordial status of Ali's relationship to the Prophet and the pre-eternal nature of divine truth.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Fadl b. al-`Abbas al-Baghdadi, a shaykh for the people of hadith narrated to us. He said: Abu’l Hasan `Ali b. Ibrahim informed us. He said: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. Ghalib b. Harb al-Dabi al-Tamtami and Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Uthman b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. They said: Yahya b. Salim and the cousin of al-Hasan b. Salih – and the latter was preferred – narrated to us. He said: Mus`ar narrated to us from `Atiyya form Jabir. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

On the gate of Paradise, it was written “There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, `Ali is the brother of the Messenger of Allah” two thousand years before Allah created the heavens and the Earth.
